notes: S2-FIX2 U2 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; Q6, §5.5.2 step 1 in two tiers): control for sub-grant-parent-present-invalid: the parent root grant is present but its only sigs entry uses an unknown algorithm (ed25519-x), so it is unverifiable E_SIG_UNVERIFIABLE (§4.4 step 5). A parent that is present but not valid for a reason other than an invalid verdict is the second tier: E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED for the sub-grant and for the note.
